correctness.rationale: For λ≥3, any first forcing step on one shore of Kmn witnesses λ−1 distinct colours on the opposite shore. Properness forces all initial colours on target shore to be the sole missing colour; after target shore fills, it is monochromatic and cannot force any missing vertex back because λ−1≥2. Thus the opposite shore was fully coloured and surjects onto λ−1 colours. Both orientations are exhaustive, and all total proper colourings are counted by P(Kmn;λ)−λQ_m(λ−1)−λQ_n(λ−1) after subtracting overlap; the two overlap families are disjoint for λ≥3. The chromatic polynomial follows by number of distinct colours on A. Independent direct state simulation compared exact rational forcing probabilities with formula for λ=3,4,5 at 11 small (m,n) profiles including cases with no forcing beyond total assignments; all matched. This is an all-λ proof, not inference from enumerated profiles.
